official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Give who the card is for, the greeting, a short message and how you sign it, and pick the look: elegant gold, balloons and confetti, floral watercolor, a funny cartoon, minimal. You get a birthday card with your words set in the design, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For friends, family, coworkers and milestone birthdays.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards or keep a list of birthdays. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
